references.text: The Lord sent his word and healed them, and he rescued them from the grave.

Surely, our sicknesses he took upon himself, and our pains he bore. Yet we considered him stricken, struck down by God and afflicted. But he was pierced for our transgressions, crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought us peace was on him, and by his wounds we are healed.

And Jesus went throughout all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every affliction among the people. And news about him spread throughout all Syria. And they brought to him all who were sick with various diseases and afflictions, those possessed by demons, those having seizures, and the paralyzed, and he healed them.

When evening came, they brought to him many who were possessed by demons. And he cast out the spirits with a word and healed all who were sick, so that what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah might be fulfilled, who says: 'He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.'
And when Jesus went ashore, he saw a great crowd, and he had compassion on them and healed their sick.

When the sun set, all those who had people with various diseases brought them to him. And he laid his hands on each one of them and healed them. Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying: 'You are the Son of God!' But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.
But Peter withdrew and went to a lonely place and prayed.

It happened that the father of Publius lay sick with fever and dysentery. Paul went in to him, prayed, laid his hands on him and healed him. When this had taken place, the rest of those on the island who had diseases also came and were healed.
